name: Tsukishima Masaki
source:
One of the members of the freediving club. Often hangs out with Nagisa, Ayumu and Nene.

[spoiler]She is actually a girl, and her family's circumstances forced her to dress up as a boy.

Her true name is Tsukishima Maki (月島 真樹).
[/spoiler]
